## Third-party decoders

`dr_flac.h` and `dr_mp3.h` are vendored from David Reid's
[dr_libs](https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs) collection.

Each file is dual-licensed under your choice of the public domain or
MIT-0. The full license statements are included at the end of each header
file. No modifications have been made.

`minimp4.h` is vendored from
[lieff/minimp4](https://github.com/lieff/minimp4), licensed under CC0
(public domain). No modifications have been made.
